name: Upload Practitioner Profile Photo
description: Upload or replace the profile photo for the currently signed-in practitioner. Fetches the practitioner's FHIR record first to resolve their ID, then streams the chosen image to FileNest and records the file reference in the practitioner.photo[] sub-resource.

intent_examples: Add a photo to my practitioner profile
when_to_use: Practitioner wants to upload or update their profile photo
Doctor wants to add a headshot to their profile
when_not_to_use: User wants to upload a patient photo
User wants to upload a clinical document or attachment

introduction: I'll help you upload a profile photo. First I'll fetch your practitioner record, then you can choose an image to upload.

workflow_steps.name: Upload Photo
workflow_steps.description: Choose a profile photo to upload. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, max 5 MB.

context_resolvers.description: Fetch the signed-in practitioner's FHIR record to resolve their integer ID for the upload path and the action URL.
